91ed62e3: If the data does not exist in ^DD("DATA") and X is not "@", jump to the Read Code section. If X is "@" and DV does not contain "R" (not required), jump to the Ask Code section. If X is "@" and DV contains "R", set X to Y and jump to the new X.
9938736b: If DV contains "P" (POINTER), set DG to DV, Y to the existing value from ^DD("DATA"), and X to the DU (data for editing). If DQ(DQ,2) exists, execute the code in DQ(DQ,2).
0be7d4ca: If DG contains "P" (POINTER) and the global node referenced by X exists, set X to the internal entry number from that node. If the entry in the 'Y' cross-reference does not exist, quit.

a760755a: If DG contains "V" (VARIABLE POINTER) and Y is a number followed by a semi-colon and open parenthesis, and the global node referenced by that expression exists, set X to the internal entry number from that node. If the entry in the 'Y' cross-reference does not exist, quit. If the .01 field of the DD for the 'X' file exists, set DG and X from the values in that node.
b1ea617c: If DG contains "D" (DATE), execute the DateDDX integration code. If DG contains "S" (SET), set Y to the piece of the X;Y: piece.

fc90550d: If X is null, set X to the existing value from ^DD("DATA"). If not jumping to Ask Code (A), not a WORDPROCESSING field (DV does not contain "#"), and the Data Condition satisfies the 'Quit if Data Required' check, quit.
cae26058: If DV does not contain "I" (INPUT TRANSFORM) or "#" (WORDPROCESSING field), go to the Read Data section.
f342f08c: Execute the Input Transform code for the field. If X is defined after the code, go to the Read Data section, else jump to the previous section (Reorder).
809cb257: End of code.
40aac76f: Set the Name of the Mumps routine (DNM) and initialize the 'DQ' variable to 1 (first executable node).
6f5773b5: Initialize variables for the first field (10.06 - SIGNED BY): DW=path, DV=validation, DU=file#, DLB=field label, DIFLD=field number.
e7b03b8e: Set the DU (Uneditable Data) variable to the file global root for File #200 (NEW PERSON).
bc78cd74: Jump to the Reorder section to begin the ValidData-Input-Read cycle.
0f22b2c8: Empty code for the X1 label (unused).
